title: Giant Sequoia: Ancient Sequoias You Can Visit
meta_description: The largest living things on earth. General Sherman in Sequoia National Park is 83.6 metres tall and roughly 2,300 to 2,700 years old.
intro: The heaviest living things on earth reached Europe only in 1853, and the timing shaped everything: Victorian Britain was at peak plant mania, and a tree that could outweigh a blue whale sold itself. Nurserymen shipped seeds by the ton, aristocrats raced to plant avenues of them, and the British even named the species Wellingtonia after the recently dead duke, a name Californians never accepted. Every sequoia outside America is therefore young, barely 170 years at most, yet many already dominate their skylines, because the species grows fast and simply does not stop. At home in the Sierra Nevada it passes 3,000 years: the President is reckoned at about 3,200, the Grizzly Giant has lost four fifths of its bark to fire and is still alive, and General Sherman stands 83.6 metres tall.
